items.html: Afterwards, from then on, until Solomon built the First Temple, she was on all the Shabbatot face to face, in the sixth aspect, as above; and on all the six weekdays she was back to back, in the third aspect mentioned above — that she was in a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot, from the chest and below, and also the light of the five [Sefirot] of ZA illuminated in her always. And this is the reason for the remembrance of the exodus from Egypt, for it was a great redemption in relation to her being, at first, in the days of the exile, only in the second aspect — a Partzuf of ten Sefirot, in the back, from the chest and below, without the illuminations of his five [Sefirot] in her; unlike the destruction of the First Temple, as will be said, with the help of God.
